profile.headline: Software Engineer at State Farm
profile.summary: I am currently a Full Stack Software developer at State Farm working on REST APIs, web application, and databases.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.insights: Skills: React.js · Java · Dynatrace · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Spring Boot · PostgreSQL · Redis · REST APIs

positions.title: Research Fellowship
positions.description: I am working on a research project with the computer science department on gamification. Our project named C.R.A.M. (Cardiovascular and Respiratory Anatomy Map) is researching how to build a new type of intelligent tutoring software.

positions.title: Tutor
positions.description: I currently tutor at the Student Athlete Academic Success Service (S.A.A.S.S.) helping student athletes succeed in their computer science, and economic courses.

positions.title: Software Solution Developer Intern
positions.description:
- I am working as a software development intern in the administrative services department of State Farm. 
- I gained experience with .NET Core MVC Web Development. My summer project will be in a production environment long term.
- I gained experience with full stack web development.
positions.insights: Skills: C# · jQuery · JavaScript · Bootstrap · ASP.NET MVC · HTML5 · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Microsoft SQL Server · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Crew Lead
positions.description: This past summer I worked at Affordable Party Tent Rentals (APTR). I was tasked as a crew leader which gave me the responsibility of leading a team of 2-5 people around the Chicago-land area completing jobs in an efficient manner with little supervision.

positions.title: Food Runner
positions.description: Last Summer I worked as a food runner at an upscale Italian restaurant in Bloomington Illinois. This role required me to be on my feet for an extended period of time and honed my customer service skills.

organizations.name: NIU Speech and Debate
organizations.description:
This past year I was elected as the president of the NIU Speech and Debate team. Speech and debate has given me communication skills that you can not get in the class room. Here are some of my awards:

- 1st Extemporaneous Speaking, Gorlock Gala (Field of ~100)
- 1st IPDA Debate, IIFA State Tournament (Field of ~30)
- 4th Extemporaneous Commentary, NSDA Nationals (Field of ~250)
- 3rd Impromptu Speaking, IHSA State Tournament (Field of ~200)
- Quarterfinalist Extemporaneous Speaking, NFA National Tournament (Field of ~150)
